changelog: 0.9.7.2 (goondocklabs fork): faster tune-in. Channels (and the guide) now start a few seconds back and send that video in one quick burst, so players like Moonfin on Apple TV start in a few seconds instead of 10 to 20. 0.9.7.1 (goondocklabs fork): the guide channel has sound. An original smooth synth loop plays under the guide when you haven't set a music folder (checkbox 'Play the built-in synth music' to turn it off). Your own music folder still wins when it's set. 0.9.7.0 (goondocklabs fork): guide channel. Turn on 'Add a guide channel' (Setup & settings, or the Guide row at the top of your package) for a Prevue style channel: a grid of what's on every channel scrolls by on its own, Up next art rotates in the top half, and a live clock ticks in the corner. Set its number, the name at the top, scroll speed, and an optional background music folder. 0.9.6.0 (goondocklabs fork): music videos. Channels can use your Music Videos library (Fill with music videos for a time period, Music videos only genre rules, tags, or adding titles by hand). MTV style artist/song/year captions, no Up Next cards between videos, and a separate no-repeat window for videos. 0.9.5.3 (goondocklabs fork): clearer Time period and Season sections on each channel page, with plain explanations and a summary of what each setting does. 0.9.5.2 (goondocklabs fork): era channels (keep only titles from a range of years, optionally bring in everything from those years) and seasonal channels (only on the guide between two dates each year). Both are on each channel's page. 0.9.5.1 (goondocklabs fork): new settings 'Allow jumping ahead' (off by default, so only what's on now can be watched, like real cable) and 'Allow restarting'. Both also apply to the remote restart/skip controls. 0.9.5: fix a nameless network channel showing up (blank studio names in metadata are skipped; non-Latin network names get their own channels instead of colliding). 0.9.4: one-click setup — a 'Connect to Live TV' button adds the M3U tuner and XMLTV guide in Jellyfin for you (and fixes them if the links go stale). 0.9.3: fresh installs pick a starter lineup from your library — the 10 channels it can fill best (no near-duplicates), numbered 101+; the rest start off. 'Re-pick my lineup' button in Setup & settings. 0.9.2: built-in channels get generic names for new installs (After Hours, Saturday Morning, Action Pack, Classic Cinema, Tearjerkers, Prestige TV, Fright Night, Kids Classics); existing installs keep their current names. 0.9.1: channel page is one page — '+ Add to channel' opens one search for titles, genres, networks & studios and keyword tags; Rebuild schedule button in the toolbar; rules show as removable chips in the AUTO-ADD line; 'Weighted mix' label; 'package' = all your channels. 0.9.0: renamed Channel Free (new logo); settings page rebuilt — channel lineup, Even mix vs Favorites first, Tonight's Mix bar, per-show options menu, changes save instantly, guide status in the header. 0.8.3: guide-update status in settings (progress bar, queued-until-nobody-is-watching, done/failed, Update guide now); self-heal removes leftover guide entries after a rebuild (no more overlapping titles). 0.8.2: Weighted mix.
